title: Using the soxe memory system
description: Use when an agent should recall prior knowledge or store durable findings in the soxe graph-memory system via the memory_* MCP tools (memory_recall / memory_write / memory_search_entities / memory_invalidate).
author: sox-ecosystem

task.description: What the agent needs from memory — e.g. 'recall prior findings about X' or 'store this durable finding'.

operation.description: The memory_* operation the task maps to.

recommended_tool.description: The memory_* MCP tool to call (memory_recall | memory_write | memory_search_entities | memory_invalidate).

guidance.description: How to perform the task: tool arguments, token_budget/scope notes, and chunking guidance for document-scale writes.
